# UX Requirements Quality Checklist: Global Top Navigation Visibility

**Purpose**: Validate the clarity, completeness, and measurability of UX-facing requirements for fixed top navigation visibility.
**Created**: 2026-08-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are top-navigation visibility requirements specified for every declared in-scope route, including fallback? [Completeness, Spec §Functional Requirements FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements documented for both route transitions and direct refresh/deep-link entry conditions? [Completeness, Spec §Functional Requirements FR-003, FR-004]
- [ ] CHK003 Are fixed-position expectations explicitly stated for all scroll states, including bottom-of-page conditions? [Completeness, Spec §Functional Requirements FR-005, FR-006]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 Is the term "fixed in a consistent viewport position" defined clearly enough to avoid multiple interpretations? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §Functional Requirements FR-005]
- [ ] CHK005 Is "all forms" unambiguously mapped to concrete page scope with no conflicting wording elsewhere? [Clarity, Consistency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the boundaries of "visibility only" sufficiently explicit to prevent accidental menu/taxonomy changes? [Clarity, Spec §Functional Requirements FR-009]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK007 Are all success criteria objectively measurable with thresholds, populations, and conditions defined? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria SC-001..SC-005]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the 1000 ms visibility target framed with clear measurement start conditions so reviewers can evaluate consistency? [Clarity, Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria SC-001]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK009 Are primary, alternate, and exception scenario classes covered in requirements language (normal navigation, fallback route, and content-unavailable paths)? [Coverage, Spec §Acceptance Scenarios, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK010 Are long-content scrolling scenarios defined for each in-scope page type rather than implied globally only? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §Acceptance Scenarios 5, §Edge Cases]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK011 Are edge-case requirements explicit about expected top-navigation behavior when page content is missing, empty, or unresolved? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §Functional Requirements FR-008]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK012 Are assumptions and constraints (static hosting, accessibility baseline, and unchanged menu semantics) reflected consistently between spec and plan language? [Assumption, Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, plan.md §Constraints]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline.
- Link to relevant resources or documentation.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference.
